registryEvidence.basis: Official Murmansk municipal and regional-government pages identify the Rosreestr/Rosкадастр services, EGRN/public cadastral-map access, and the city service for approving a land-plot placement scheme on a cadastral plan. This establishes custodianship and local administrative involvement, not an open parcel-data feed.
